notes: Bare array. Ordered by normalized ISO day DESC (both date formats normalized via _ISO_DAY_EXPR) then created_at DESC. date is echoed verbatim as stored. created_at AND updated_at both default to CURRENT_TIMESTAMP at insert (UTC 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'), so updated_at is never null. Supports ?start_date=&end_date= filtering on the RAW date string (lexicographic BETWEEN, not normalized). contract change: US-format input dates are normalized to ISO before storage, so the entry POSTed as '8/2/2025' is stored and echoed as '2025-08-02' (its position in the list is unchanged — _ISO_DAY_EXPR already sorted it there).
